name: 71295 · Winnsboro, LA
findings: ZIP 71295 (Winnsboro) has 34 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 71295 (Winnsboro) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 6 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
